say:1:1034114001:0.text: I've had enough! I don't know why so many people like to eat radishes dipped in wisteria vine jam.
say:1:1034114001:0.source_cn: 我受够了！我不明白为什么有那么多人喜欢吃葱萝时蘸紫豆藤...
say:1:1034114001:0.male: I've had enough! I don't know why so many people like to eat radishes dipped in wisteria vine jam.
say:1:1034114001:0.female: I've had enough! I don't know why so many people like to eat radishes dipped in wisteria vine jam.

say:2:1034114002:0.text: Some people even think that river water brewed with skirtweed actually tastes good... I wish to leave this demented place as soon as possible.
say:2:1034114002:0.source_cn: 甚至还有人觉得，用裙草泡出来的水很好喝……我想早点离开...
say:2:1034114002:0.male: Some people even think that river water brewed with skirtweed actually tastes good... I wish to leave this demented place as soon as possible.
say:2:1034114002:0.female: Some people even think that river water brewed with skirtweed actually tastes good... I wish to leave this demented place as soon as possible.

say:5:1034114004:1.text: A village in the Dark Forest, right? I heard it's similar to Taran.
say:5:1034114004:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林的村子对吧？据说那里和塔兰村差不多……
say:5:1034114004:1.male: A village in the Dark Forest, right? I heard it's similar to Taran.
say:5:1034114004:1.female: A village in the Dark Forest, right? I heard it's similar to Taran.

say:6:1034114005:1.text: Although it's said Lunadorf is beautiful, I bet it'd just feel like a larger version of Taran.
say:6:1034114005:1.source_cn: 虽然我听说过月湖村很美，但我觉得……月湖村就是大一点的...
say:6:1034114005:1.male: Although it's said Lunadorf is beautiful, I bet it'd just feel like a larger version of Taran.
say:6:1034114005:1.female: Although it's said Lunadorf is beautiful, I bet it'd just feel like a larger version of Taran.

say:8:1034114006:0.text: Of course, I've heard of that place! It's in the Lightbearer Empire. There is, I've been told, a massive statue of Dura there.
say:8:1034114006:0.source_cn: 当然听说过啦！那是耀光帝国的领地，据说那里还有一尊艾雅...
say:8:1034114006:0.male: Of course, I've heard of that place! It's in the Lightbearer Empire. There is, I've been told, a massive statue of Dura there.
say:8:1034114006:0.female: Of course, I've heard of that place! It's in the Lightbearer Empire. There is, I've been told, a massive statue of Dura there.

say:9:1034114007:0.text: Although we worship the goddess Misarte here, we also acknowledge and honor Dura.
say:9:1034114007:0.source_cn: 虽然我们信奉的神明是弥萨忒大人，但我也很尊敬艾雅女神。
say:9:1034114007:0.male: Although we worship the goddess Misarte here, we also acknowledge and honor Dura.
say:9:1034114007:0.female: Although we worship the goddess Misarte here, we also acknowledge and honor Dura.

say:10:1034114008:1.text: This is a good idea. I'm itching to move!
say:10:1034114008:1.source_cn: 太棒了，我已经蠢蠢欲动啦！
say:10:1034114008:1.male: This is a good idea. I'm itching to move!
say:10:1034114008:1.female: This is a good idea. I'm itching to move!

say:11:1034114009:0.text: Right! That town that grows the best wheat, yes?
say:11:1034114009:0.source_cn: 哦哦！是种小麦的那个村子吧？
say:11:1034114009:0.male: Right! That town that grows the best wheat, yes?
say:11:1034114009:0.female: Right! That town that grows the best wheat, yes?

say:12:1034114010:0.text: I heard the people there make many wheat-based delicacies, all delicious.
say:12:1034114010:0.source_cn: 我听说，那里的居民会用小麦做出各种各样的食物，味道一定...
say:12:1034114010:0.male: I heard the people there make many wheat-based delicacies, all delicious.
say:12:1034114010:0.female: I heard the people there make many wheat-based delicacies, all delicious.

say:13:1034114011:1.text: As long as the food isn't made with weird herbs, I'll be happy! Now I can't wait to leave!
say:13:1034114011:1.source_cn: 只要不是用草药做的食物，我都喜欢！我已经等不及要出发了！
say:13:1034114011:1.male: As long as the food isn't made with weird herbs, I'll be happy! Now I can't wait to leave!
say:13:1034114011:1.female: As long as the food isn't made with weird herbs, I'll be happy! Now I can't wait to leave!
